image.alt: Kitchen remodeling on Hilton Head Island: gray shaker cabinets, white counters and a navy blue island with bar stools

intro.h2: Kitchen Remodeling in Hilton Head, Built for Island Homes
paragraphs: Hilton Head Home Solutions handles kitchen remodeling on Hilton Head Island for full-time homes, villas and rentals. One recent villa kitchen was opened up to the living area, then fitted with new cabinets, granite, backsplash, faucet and sink.

Homeowners keep coming back with a second job. Kathy B. says they complete the job as quoted and on time. Debbie T. needed an emergency bathroom redo while she was away, and it was finished within 10 days. The same crew also paints, hangs drywall, lays flooring and handles small repairs, so one call to the Executive Park Road office covers most of the house.

services.h2: Remodeling Services on Hilton Head Island

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: From closed-in villa kitchens to full rentals, the team replaces old cabinets, installs granite or stone counters, tiles the backsplash and sets a new faucet and sink. Opening a wall to the living room is one of the changes they post about most.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with light gray shaker cabinets, white veined countertop, mosaic tile backsplash and glass pendant lights

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom remodels and urgent redos. One homeowner who could not get to the island right away had an emergency bathroom rebuilt within 10 days, with the project manager handling everything on site and the space cleaned up afterwards.

items.name: Flooring, including epoxy
items.blurb: New floors to tie a remodel together, from wood-look plank through the kitchen and living area to epoxy floors for garages and gyms. For epoxy, you choose the color and the crew handles the prep and the pour.

image.alt: Galley kitchen with light wood-look plank flooring, stainless steel appliances and gray cabinets

items.name: Painting, drywall and carpentry
items.blurb: Painting, drywall repair and finish carpentry for single rooms or whole homes. Their Facebook page lists painting, carpentry, drywall, flooring and general remodeling alongside kitchens and baths, and they say no job is too small to call about.

image.alt: Bunk room with white shiplap walls, built-in white bunk beds, a dresser and a wall-mounted TV

why_choose_us.h2: Why Island Homeowners Call Them Back

items.title: Done as quoted, on time
items.text: Kathy B. wrote that they complete the job as quoted and on time, and called the company extremely well run. Two reviewers mention planning their next project with the same team.

items.title: They can work while you are away
items.text: Debbie T. could not get to the island right away. Fernanda, the project manager, took care of everything and the emergency bathroom redo was finished within 10 days.

items.title: Clean job sites
items.text: Reviewers say the work was quality and the crew cleaned up well. That matters in a villa or rental where guests or tenants are back in soon after.

items.title: Inside and outside the house
items.text: Susan J. hired them for several projects both inside and outside her home. Kitchens, baths, floors, paint, drywall and carpentry are all handled by one local team.

about.h2: A Local Team With 10 Years on the Island
about.text: Hilton Head Home Solutions works out of an office at 18 Executive Park Road on Hilton Head Island and has 10 years of experience behind it. The team covers painting, carpentry, drywall, flooring and kitchen and bath remodeling, so homeowners do not have to line up separate trades. Fernanda Lossada is the project manager homeowners deal with day to day, and reviewers mention her by name. The owners answer their Google reviews personally, and several customers say they are already planning their next project with the team.

image.alt: Bright open dining and living area with a wood-plank vaulted ceiling, wood-look floors and windows facing the water

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (843) 227-4087 or send a message about the room you want to change. Estimates are free, as the team says on Facebook.

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: You get a written quote for the scope agreed on site. Reviewers say the work was completed as quoted.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The crew handles demolition, cabinets, counters, tile, flooring and paint, with the project manager keeping you updated if you are off the island.

steps.title: Clean up and walkthrough
steps.text: The site is cleaned up and you walk through the finished room together before the job is closed out.

items.name: Kathy B.
items.text: Hilton Head Home Solutions is extremely well run. They are very responsive, they complete the job as quoted and on time, and the workmanship is excellent. In addition, they are very pleasant to work with.

items.name: Debbie T.
items.text: We had an emergency redo for a bathroom.  They were able to get it done within 10 days.  Fernanda was great to work with and took care of everything since we were not able to get there immediately.  The work was quality and they cleaned up well.  We are ready to a planned renovation next with them.  Highly recommend the company.

items.name: Susan J.
items.text: I contracted Hilton Head Home Solutions to work on several projects, both inside and outside my home. Each job was performed with such professionalism and met with my full satisfaction. I highly recommend this company for any project you might have. You won't be disappointed!

service_area.text: The office is at 18 Executive Park Rd #3 on Hilton Head Island, and the projects the team shares are island homes, villas and rentals. If you live on the island or own a place here that you visit, call to check whether your project and timing fit their schedule. Owners who are away can still get work done, as one reviewer did.

items.a: Yes. Hilton Head Home Solutions invites homeowners to contact them for a free estimate. Call (843) 227-4087 during business hours, Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 5 PM, or send a message through Facebook or Instagram and they will get back to you to set up a visit.

items.q: What kind of work do you take on?
items.a: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling, flooring including epoxy floors, painting, drywall, carpentry and general remodeling. Their recent kitchen work includes opening a villa kitchen to the living room with new cabinets, granite, backsplash, faucet and sink. They also say no job is too small, so small repairs are worth a call.

items.q: Can you manage a project if I am not on the island?
items.a: One homeowner who could not get there right away had an emergency bathroom redo finished within 10 days, and wrote that Fernanda, the project manager, took care of everything. Call to talk through access, updates and timing for your own project before work starts.

items.q: Where is your office and when are you open?
items.a: The office is at 18 Executive Park Rd #3, Hilton Head Island, SC 29928. The listed hours are Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and the office is closed on Sunday. Calling ahead before you visit is the easiest way to make sure someone is there.

items.q: How long have you been in business?
items.a: The company says it has 10 years of experience behind it. On Google it holds a 5.0 rating from 6 reviews, and the owners reply to reviews personally. Reviewers mention jobs done as quoted and on time, careful clean up, and coming back for a second project.

final_cta.text: Call the Hilton Head Island office for a free estimate on your kitchen, bathroom or next project.
